column1: Every run has its own sheet (named after the month, e.g. "May 2060") with one row per region, timestamp and dataset. A hit is one SHACL result. Only Warnings and Violations count; Infos are ignored. A dataset's hits are added up over all timestamps of that run.\nEvery number on this sheet is a formula: click a cell to see how it is calculated. Hover over a column header for its description.
